form.HOT: Three strong appearances in a row. The staff is talking about what is working across this run, and how to keep it repeatable when opponents adjust.
form.COLD: The last three appearances have been difficult. The staff wants one manageable adjustment, then evidence that you can build your rhythm back.
form.SURGING: Each of your last three appearances has been a step forward. People in the building are noticing the progress before it becomes a headline.
form.INCONSISTENT: Your recent tape has shown both ends of the range. The question around the building is which habits can bring those performances closer together.
form.STEADY: Your recent appearances have given the staff a clearer baseline. The next conversation is about what you can add to it.

tendencies.Team-first: You have repeatedly brought the conversation back to the group. The room has started to expect that from you.
tendencies.Ambitious: You have made your ambitions clear more than once. This conversation starts with the understanding that you are looking for a bigger role.
tendencies.Accountability: You have repeatedly chosen responsibility and measurable commitments. The staff remembers that when it asks what comes next.
tendencies.Defiant: You have pushed back on the situation repeatedly. Nobody expects you to accept the next answer without a conversation.
